name: calls/prefill
doc: the prefill call's contract, the facts that do not depend on the depth: `prefill` 1, the value width and the decay the carry will serve, the call's length and streams and whether a state rides it. It is composed only by the OWED descriptors (hardware/descriptors/owed): the prefill kernels are not built, so nothing here is in the full contract. The depth, the level widths and the per-level walks are a depth part's (calls/depth1 .. calls/depth4).

d_v.declared_by: docs/open-work.md row A-h: the value widths the carry's cells are drawn at, 2 up to 128 (the central carry cells' `dv` 32, 64 and 128); the prefill launch function (row A-f: the carve, the window, the grid and the segment length) fixes the range when the carry is built; the padding seam (docs/internals/padding.md) serves the widths between

decay.declared_by: docs/api.md section 1.1: a prefill's decay is refused -- decay is decode's (section 3), outside the first paper's scope

prefill.declared_by: this part is the prefill call: the prefill fact is 1

tokens.declared_by: docs/open-work.md row A-h: the prefill launch function (row A-f: the carve, the window, the grid and the segment length) fixes this range when the carry is built; until then it is declared wide; the range is the widest a token index of the kernels holds (int32)

batch_heads.declared_by: docs/open-work.md row A-h: the prefill launch function (row A-f: the carve, the window, the grid and the segment length) fixes this range when the carry is built; until then it is declared wide; the range is declared as wide as decode's (docs/api.md#batch-heads)

stateful.declared_by: docs/api.md section 1: a prefill is stateless (None) or carries a state in and out; either is a lawful call
